name: page-scanner
description: Capture a web page from your own Chrome as a PDF whose text stays text, or as a PNG, a JPEG or Markdown. The MCP server that lists your tabs and captures one, the skill that tells the agent when and how to use it, a skill that writes a site's DESIGN.md from what it measured, and a skill that researches from captured pages, citing what they declare and checking every quote against the capture.
